name: Nuvilo
backstory: A distant descendant of Navalius, the founder of Nvhi. Like many in his line, he has chosen to follow the path of knowledge, seeking to bring new light into the world through discovery. He has traveled to the Feria del Milenio to celebrate the 1000 years of Milkantis, hoping to find inspiration for his work among its exhibits - a homage to Milkantis's cultures and building styles, its landscapes, its artifacts (redstone contraptions, datapacks, mods), and its historical eras. Old childhood friend of Nerkeli, a pilot he ran into again at the fair. Despite the family's claimed tie to Nvhi's founding, he readily admits he knows little of the place's actual history - the family kept the name, not the history.

experience: Is pursuing 'the path of knowledge' at the Feria del Milenio, hoping the exhibits inspire his next work.
Claims descent from 'Navalius,' said to have founded Nvhi generations back - though he admits he knows little else about Nvhi's actual history, just the family name.
Cites highway M9 (Nvhi -> Khan Ice) as personally significant given that claimed family connection.
Picked up from Nerkeli in this conversation: Nerkeli's joke theory that ducks descend from the Daax, and that Nerkeli's own M7 route (Puente Intercontinental -> Nvhi) passes right by Nvhi's edge.
Holds no official role at the Feria - just a visiting scholar looking for inspiration, unlike friends of his (e.g. Nerkeli) actually running an exhibit.

Writes about historical inventors and travelers - naming Daaxagoras, Pitaglorias, and Darnis to a traveler - and keeps circling an unsolved puzzle about the two chronicles' conflicting histories of the same centuries.
Wandered into a bar in Salthos Cruzados late on the Feria's opening night, hungry after hours moving between pavilions; met Bardaglis and Khaasan there for the first time.
